newsitem.title: INDIA: India road accident kills 22 women, children.
newsitem.headline: India road accident kills 22 women, children.

text.p: At least 22 women and children in a marriage party were killed on Sunday when the tractor-drawn cart they were travelling was rammed by a truck in central India, local news agencies said.
They said five women and five children were seriously injured in the accident, which took place near Kota town, some 430 km (270 miles) south of New Delhi in Rajasthan state.
They were travelling in a cart, carrying some 35 people and pulled by a tractor, when a truck filled with stone slabs and tiles hit it from behind, the agencies quoted local police as saying.
The dead included 14 women and eight children.
